mapper.select:
select w1.id, w1.tutor_id, c.id as classroom_id, c.name as classroom_name, c.classroom_number, w1.working_date, w1.transportation_fee,
w2.id as lesson_id, w2.work_id as lesson_work_id, w2.start_time as lesson_start_time, w2.end_time as lesson_end_time, w2.break_minutes as lesson_break_minutes, w2.period_code_m as lesson_period_code_m, w2.period_code_k as lesson_period_code_k, w2.period_code_s as lesson_period_code_s, w2.period_code_a as lesson_period_code_a, w2.period_code_b as lesson_period_code_b, w2.period_code_c as lesson_period_code_c, w2.period_code_d as lesson_period_code_d,
w3.id as office_id, w3.work_id as office_work_id, w3.start_time as office_start_time, w3.end_time as office_end_time,
w4.id as other_id, w4.work_id as other_work_id, w4.start_time as other_start_time, w4.end_time as other_end_time, w4.break_minutes as other_break_minutes, w4.description as other_description from works as w1 left join lesson_work_details as w2 on w1.id = w2.work_id left join office_work_details as w3 on w1.id = w3.work_id left join other_work_details as w4 on w1.id = w4.work_id left join classrooms as c on w1.classroom_id = c.id where w1.tutor_id = #{tutorId} and w1.working_date between #{dateFrom} and #{dateTo}

select w1.id, w1.tutor_id, c.id as classroom_id, c.name as classroom_name, c.classroom_number, w1.working_date, w1.transportation_fee,

w3.id as office_id, w3.work_id as office_work_id, w3.start_time as office_start_time, w3.end_time as office_end_time,
w4.id as other_id, w4.work_id as other_work_id, w4.start_time as other_start_time, w4.end_time as other_end_time, w4.break_minutes as other_break_minutes, w4.description as other_description from works as w1 left join lesson_work_details as w2 on w1.id = w2.work_id left join office_work_details as w3 on w1.id = w3.work_id left join other_work_details as w4 on w1.id = w4.work_id left join classrooms as c on w1.classroom_id = c.id where w1.id = #{workId}
mapper.insert: insert into works (tutor_id, classroom_id, working_date, transportation_fee) values (#{tutorId}, #{classroomId}, #{workingDate}, #{transportationFee})
mapper.update: update works set classroom_id = #{classroomId}, working_date = #{workingDate}, transportation_fee = #{transportationFee} where id = #{id}
